alert: Latency p95 above threshold on frontend

root_cause.summary: The accounting service is taking many seconds to process order-consumed requests, likely due to a downstream database slowdown, which inflates overall request latency observed at the frontend.

evidence.why_it_matters: accounting shows SLOW status with p95 latency 15000 ms
accounting order-consumed span takes ~57 seconds self time, dominating request latency

proposed_action.reason: accounting service latency is causing frontend p95 to exceed threshold

timeline.event: Alert received: Latency p95 above threshold on frontend

prevention: Add DB query performance monitoring and autoscale accounting service to handle load spikes
